parole.testo: Reborrowing from Ottoman Turkish لیمان (liman), (corresponding to the Medieval Byzantine form λιμεώνας (limeṓnas) or λιμνιώνας (limniṓnas), diminutive λιμενάρι (limenári)), from Hellenistic Koine Greek λῐμένιον (lĭménion), diminutive of Ancient Greek λῐμήν (lĭmḗn, “harbor”). See also λειμών (leimṓn)
